# My plan for this year

Alright, let me think through this. I've been doing wheat-maize on these 10 mu for 40 years now, so I mostly know what I'm doing. My body isn't what it used to be, but my two grown kids still help out at busy times, and the wife handles a lot of the day-to-day.

## Wheat (winter)

Last year my wheat did alright — about 430 kg/mu, not bad. I'll plant around October 10th, same as always, right after I get the maize off. I saved some seed from last year's harvest but I'll also buy a bit of 济麦22 (Jimai 22) from the co-op because my neighbor老王 said his yields went up after switching. Mix them together.

Before planting I put down two bags of 二铵 (diammonium phosphate) per mu — that's what we've always done, about 40 kg. Then at jointing in spring I topdress with a bag of urea, maybe 15 kg/mu, more if the field looks yellow. My nephew who went to农校 once told me I should split the urea, but that's extra walking for an old man — I just do it once.

Water: winter irrigation before the ground freezes, then one at jointing, and if it's dry a third at grain filling. The electric bill for the well adds up, so I don't irrigate unless the wheat really needs it.

Herbicide after emergence — the weeds have been bad since we stopped deep plowing. Maybe one spray for aphids at flowering if I see them.

## Maize (summer)

Right after wheat harvest in June, no time to waste. I pay the machine guy to come rotary-till and drill the maize in one pass — we usually finish within 3-4 days of the combine leaving. I buy hybrid seed, 郑单958 or whatever the shop has that's similar, about 50 yuan for a bag that does my whole 10 mu.

At planting I put compound fertilizer in the row, then at the big-bell stage (大喇叭口) I side-dress urea — maybe 15 kg/mu. If July-August rains are good I skip irrigation; if it's dry during tasseling I'll water once. That's the critical time.

Weeds: one herbicide spray after planting. Armyworm has been a problem some years so I keep insecticide ready.

Expect 480 kg/mu if the weather behaves. Last year was 460, year before was 500.

## Money

My total budget is tight — probably around 8,500 yuan for inputs across both seasons. I keep some cash back for the electric bill and in case something breaks. I don't take loans for farming, never have.
